If you’re ordering in India and have up to two weeks, I’d shortlist these three. The sweet spot is roughly ₹500–₹1,600: enough personalization to feel thoughtful without paying a big premium just for “custom.”

IGP Personalized Timeless Anniversary Golden Metal Frame
₹745•Elegant gold-tone frame for anniversary memories.
Personalised Couple Photo Star Map Anniversary Gift
₹1,597•Custom star map with couple photo for special occasions.
Personalized Laser Engraved Wooden Photo Frame
₹799•Laser-engraved wooden frame adds a personal touch.
Give feedback
My ranking
Choice	Typical price	Best for	Main trade-off
1. Personalized metal frame	~₹745	Safe, elegant anniversary gift	Less emotionally unique than a multi-photo gift
2. Couple star-map / personalized art	~₹1,597	More romantic + memorable	Higher price; design quality matters
3. Engraved wooden frame	~₹799	Warm, personal, classic	Can look slightly “gift-shop” depending on engraving

1. Best value: personalized metal/desk frame
Good balance of price, presentation and personalization. I’d choose this if you want something elegant rather than overly romantic.

2. Best emotional value: star-map/personalized artwork
Worth the extra ₹800-ish if you can tie it to a meaningful date/place. It feels more deliberately chosen than simply putting a photo in a frame.

3. Best budget option: engraved wooden frame
Probably the best choice if you have a great couple photo + names/date/message. Personalized wooden frames are commonly around ₹700–₹900, and some sellers offer express delivery within 4–6 days. 
Play Creative

What I'd check before ordering

Actual delivery date to the recipient's pincode — don't rely only on “ships in 2–3 days.” Some personalized sellers quote 3–7 business days, while others can take 7–10 days. 
FotoMandir
+1

Photo quality — use the original high-resolution photo, not a WhatsApp screenshot. 
Nivaraprint

Preview before production — particularly important for text, faces and cropping.

Replacement policy — personalized products generally can't be returned simply because you changed your mind; damage/printing-error replacement is much more useful.

Packaging — especially for acrylic, glass or framed products.

Personalization limit — names + date + one short line usually looks better than a long romantic paragraph.

Express shipping cost — ₹100–₹200 extra is worth it if the standard ETA gets close to your two-week deadline.

If I had to pick just one: I'd go with the personalized wooden/metal frame around ₹700–₹900, and spend the effort on choosing a genuinely good photo and a meaningful one-line message. That usually gives better value than a ₹2,500+ novelty gift.

If you tell me your budget and whether this is for your partner, parents, or another couple, I can narrow it to 3 specific gifts and check delivery options.

For a 50-person Indian company, I’d make the shortlist myBiz, Cleartrip OOO and FCM Travel. Based on currently published terms, the cost structure and trade-offs look like this:

Option	Cost today	Cancellation / support	Key trade-off
MakeMyTrip myBiz	₹0 annual subscription; negotiated service fee per booking. A 1.5% payment-gateway fee can apply to wallet/card payments. 
MakeMyTrip
+1
	Special corporate fares can offer free cancellation/date changes; otherwise supplier fare rules apply. 24×7 support. 
MakeMyTrip Biz
+1
	Lowest-friction option for a 50-person India-first company, but it's primarily a platform/intermediary rather than a fully outsourced TMC.
Cleartrip OOO	No subscription or extra platform charges advertised; quote/booking economics still need confirmation. 
OOO
	Corporate fares and approvals; supplier cancellation rules apply.	Potentially the lowest platform-cost alternative, but clarify exactly what human servicing is included.
FCM Travel	Contract/quote based, with service fees negotiated.	Published terms allow cancellation charges up to 100%, plus amendment/reissue charges; 24×7 emergency assistance. 
FCM Travel
	More appropriate if you want outsourced travel management and international support, but potentially higher servicing cost.
Purchase-ready shortlist

1. myBiz — start here. Its ₹0 subscription, corporate fares, GST/expense tooling and 24×7 support make the economics particularly straightforward for 50 employees. 
MakeMyTrip Biz

2. FCM — get a competing quote. Worth it if employees travel internationally or you need genuine travel-manager intervention rather than self-service.

3. Cleartrip OOO — use as the price benchmark. Its published “no subscription/no extra charges” proposition makes it useful for negotiating myBiz/FCM pricing. 
OOO

Before paying, demand these 7 numbers

Per-flight booking/service fee

Hotel booking fee/markup

Cancellation + date-change fee on top of airline charges

International booking fee

After-hours/emergency fee

Corporate-card/payment-gateway fee

Annual minimum commitment, if any

Also get refund SLA, dedicated account-manager SLA, GST-credit responsibility, unused-ticket-credit handling, and escalation terms in writing.

Bottom line: For a 50-person company, I would quote myBiz and Cleartrip head-to-head, then use FCM if the company values high-touch travel management enough to justify a higher contracted fee.
